Code Review by Qodo

🐞 Bugs (3)
1. Photo taps duplicate batch downloads 🐞 Bug
>
>Description >
> >
>save(p) records a photo in saveAll.handed but neither checks whether Save all is busy nor
>prevents the batch from using its earlier snapshot. If someone taps an individual photo during a
>laptop download batch, its download starts immediately and the batch downloads the same photo again
>when it reaches that entry.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[web/index.html[R327-328]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/pull/133/files#diff-8f62b6ced28d3396b501d2e89a2e7cb761d16cd7dc977aebece03d4a5da5c24eR327-R328) > >```diff >+ if (navigator.canShare?.({ files: [file] })) navigator.share({ files: [file] }).then(() => saveAll.handed.add(p.pid), () => {}); >+ else { downloadFile(file); saveAll.handed.add(p.pid); } >``` >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >An individual photo tap can download a file already queued in a running Save all batch; pending individual shares can also overlap a batch share. >## Fix Focus Areas >- web/index.html[322-343] >- web/saveall.js[32-55] >## Recommended Fix >Coordinate both controls through shared in-flight state. Prevent an individual save from starting for a photo reserved by the batch, and re-check shared handoff state immediately before each queued download. Preserve the rule that a cancelled or failed share does not mark a photo as handed over. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/857ecaf9-0c37-412c-b4f8-967bc449aa01?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/857ecaf9-0c37-412c-b4f8-967bc449aa01)

2. An unsettled share blocks later saves 🐞 Bug
>
>Description >
> >
>tap() keeps busy true until share(list) settles, with no recovery path for a promise that
>remains pending. If the browser never settles that promise, every later Save all tap returns “Still
>saving” for the rest of the page session, including taps made after new photos arrive.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[web/saveall.js[R39-42]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/pull/133/files#diff-1197fbbadbb14a53258dbd75d68b20c8bf37f2e49062120e60b6b11916a8861fR39-R42) > >```diff >+ busy = true; >+ try { >+ if (sharing) { >+ try { await share(list); } catch (e) { >``` >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >A share promise that never settles leaves Save all permanently busy, so the person cannot use it for later photos without reloading. >## Fix Focus Areas >- web/saveall.js[32-56] >## Recommended Fix >Provide an explicit recovery path for a stalled share while preserving the synchronous call to `share()` inside the tap. Track the outstanding operation so a late resolution cannot mark photos handed over incorrectly or race a recovered batch; do not automatically launch a second share sheet while the first may still be open. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/e5a13edd-0c14-4646-be34-149d9f0a661b?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/e5a13edd-0c14-4646-be34-149d9f0a661b)

3. Verifying photos disappear from counts 🐞 Bug
>
>Description >
> >
>saveBatch() counts an unfinished photo only while its ID remains in incoming, but the chunk
>handler removes that ID before asynchronous fingerprint verification finishes. A tap during that
>verification interval finds the photo in neither incoming nor files, so Save all can say
>“Nothing new to save” instead of counting it as still arriving.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[web/saveall.js[17]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/pull/133/files#diff-1197fbbadbb14a53258dbd75d68b20c8bf37f2e49062120e60b6b11916a8861fR17-R17) > >```diff >+ for (const fid of incoming.keys()) if (!fid.startsWith('thumb:') && !files.has(fid)) arriving++; >``` >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >A received photo drops out of both Save all counts between removal from the incoming-transfer map and completion of its fingerprint check. >## Fix Focus Areas >- web/index.html[205-210] >- web/index.html[221-238] >- web/saveall.js[10-18] >## Recommended Fix >Track full files awaiting verification separately, and include that state in Save all's arriving count until verification succeeds or fails. Keep completed transfers from triggering duplicate verification if their incoming-map lifetime changes. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
